name: Dad Health consented funnel / production
description: Consented occurrences only, not all registered accounts. Missing consent is not tracked drop-off. Billing stages are activation-blocked until attributable consent and verified transition context exist. Purchases without trials are outside this trial funnel. No 50% offer exists. Remote delivery remains off pending retention approval.

panels.name: Funnel stage totals and distinct accounts (not sequential conversion)

source.query: SELECT event, count() AS event_total, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS unique_accounts FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND not startsWith(distinct_id, 'anonymous-') AND event IN ('onboarding_started','onboarding_completed','first_checkin','paywall_viewed','trial_started','trial_converted') AND (event NOT IN ('trial_started','trial_converted','trial_cancelled','subscription_cancelled') OR properties.environment = 'production') GROUP BY event ORDER BY event
